blocks.text: Kris Aquino delighted her fans as she once again made a public appearance, joining a recent brand event alongside her youngest son, Bimby Aquino. The mother and son attended the event of a personal hygiene brand on Tuesday, Sept. 15, where they had a conversation with “Dogshow Divas” hosts Baus Rufo and Macoy Dubs. During the program, the Queen of All Media also gamely responded to several questions that tackled topics including life lessons and health.
